Nasi Lemak Biasa.note: Sambal tumis with belacan = crustaceans; fried ikan bilis = fish; roasted peanuts; half boiled egg. Santan is not milk. Spicy = 2. Add-on lauk are modifiers and not counted.

Nasi Lemak Ayam Goreng.note: Sambal tumis with belacan = crustaceans; fried ikan bilis = fish; roasted peanuts; half boiled egg. Santan is not milk. Spicy = 2. Add-on lauk are modifiers and not counted. Ayam goreng coated in rice flour, so no gluten.

Nasi Lemak Rendang Daging.note: Sambal tumis with belacan = crustaceans; fried ikan bilis = fish; roasted peanuts; half boiled egg. Santan is not milk. Spicy = 2. Add-on lauk are modifiers and not counted. Kerisik is toasted coconut, not a tree nut.

Nasi Lemak Sotong.note: Sambal tumis with belacan = crustaceans; fried ikan bilis = fish; roasted peanuts; half boiled egg. Santan is not milk. Spicy = 2. Add-on lauk are modifiers and not counted. Squid = molluscs.

Nasi Lemak Special.note: Sambal tumis with belacan = crustaceans; fried ikan bilis = fish; roasted peanuts; half boiled egg. Santan is not milk. Spicy = 2. Add-on lauk are modifiers and not counted. Squid = molluscs; fried egg = egg. Ayam goreng in rice flour.

Nasi Lemak Vegetarian.note: No belacan, no ikan bilis. Tempeh = soy; roasted peanuts; boiled egg, so vegetarian but not vegan. Spicy = 2.

Ayam Goreng.note: Rice flour coating, no wheat, no egg stated. Not spicy. Same price as the Tambah Lauk add-on.

Rendang Daging.note: Coconut milk is not milk; kerisik (toasted coconut) is not a tree nut. Mildly spicy = 1.

Paru Goreng.note: Beef lung, turmeric, no flour stated. Not spicy. Sold out in extra.json.

Sambal Kerang.note: Cockles = molluscs; belacan = crustaceans. Sold out in extra.json.

Roti Bakar Kaya.note: Wheat bread; kaya = egg (coconut is not milk); butter = milk. Pagi menu only.

Telur Separuh Masak.note: Eggs; soy sauce = soy + gluten. White pepper only, not spicy. Pagi menu only.

Bihun Goreng.note: Rice vermicelli has no gluten, but sweet soy sauce (kicap manis) = soy + gluten. Egg. No belacan stated. Mildly spicy = 1. Pagi menu only.

Lontong.note: Dried shrimp and belacan = crustaceans; tempeh = soy; egg. Glass noodles assumed mung bean (no wheat). Coconut milk is not milk. Mildly spicy = 1. Pagi menu only.

Karipap.note: Wheat pastry with vegetable shortening (merchant tags vegan). Mildly spicy = 1.

Kuih Seri Muka.note: Glutinous rice and cornstarch have no gluten; custard = egg; coconut milk is not milk.

Kuih Lapis.note: Rice and tapioca flour, coconut milk. No allergens.

Onde-Onde.note: Glutinous rice (no gluten), palm sugar, coconut (not a tree nut). Price is for three balls.

Kopi.note: Butter-roasted beans and condensed milk = milk (rule o).

Kopi O.note: No milk added, but beans roasted with butter = milk; vegetarian, not vegan (rule o).

Milo.note: Malted barley = gluten; condensed milk = milk.
